title: sso-vue: published dist bakes VITE_SSO_* env vars to undefined — sign-in impossible
description: Root cause of B2C sign-in crashing in philly-311 dev (TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0') at RedirectClient.getRedirectUri — MSAL does redirectUri[0] on undefined). @phila/sso-vue 0.2.0's dist (npm AND the local build at ~/Projects/phila-identity/packages/sso-vue/dist) contains ZERO import.meta.env references: vite lib mode statically replaced import.meta.env.VITE_SSO_CLIENT_ID/TENANT/AUTHORITY_DOMAIN/REDIRECT_URI with undefined at library build time (vars unset in the build env), so the dist literally ships 'clientId: void 0, redirectUri: void 0'. Source (createB2CPlugin.ts:27-30) is correct — the docs say the plugin reads the consuming app's VITE_SSO_* vars, but that only works if the references survive into the dist. Fix in phila-identity: make the env access survive lib build (e.g. bracket access import.meta.env['VITE_SSO_CLIENT_ID'], which vite's define doesn't statically replace, or add explicit config options to B2CPluginOptions), rebuild, bump, publish; then bump the dep in pinboard-3. Until then, sign-in cannot work in ANY consumer of the published package. philly-311's /reports page is complete but its signed-in visual QA is blocked on this.

title: map-core: console error on every load — Pictometry worker chunk 439.js missing from dist, spawned eagerly
description:
UPSTREAM bug in @phila/phila-ui-map-core@1.1.1; affects every app that imports anything from the package.

Symptom: "Unexpected token '<'" in the console on every page load of philly-311 dev.

Root cause chain (verified via Worker-constructor hook + request interception in Playwright):
1. dist/components.mjs line 1 statically imports ~30 shared exports (including Map, which we do use) from ./PictometryPanel-I2P6l7HN.js — the build put the shared module graph into the PictometryPanel chunk, so ANY import of map-core loads the whole Pictometry bundle eagerly.
2. Inside that chunk, the webpack-bundled Pictometry/EagleView embedded API module ('./src/js/api/index.js', executed via __webpack_require__ at module-init time) calls new Worker('439.js') as a side effect of being imported — no user opt-in, no laziness.
3. 439.js (the webpack worker chunk of the EagleView embedded API) is NOT shipped in the map-core dist at all. Vite dev serves index.html as SPA fallback -> worker parses HTML as JS -> Unexpected token '<'. In a production build the request would 404/fallback on the app origin the same way.

Impact on philly-311: console noise + one dead request per load; we don't use Pictometry, so no feature breakage. Any consumer that DOES use Pictometry has a dead worker.

Suggested upstream fixes (phila-ui-4 repo, alongside bead map-core-k8c): create the worker lazily (on Pictometry activation, not import); ship the worker asset in dist with a resolvable URL (new URL(..., import.meta.url)); fix chunking so importing Map doesn't pull the Pictometry bundle.

Repro/diagnosis one-liner: hook window.Worker in an init script and load '/' — stack points at PictometryPanel chunk ./src/js/api/index.js.

title: Map zoom lag: warning flood + per-frame marker re-renders
description: Profiled with CDP during continuous wheel zoom (dev): worst frame 486ms. Costs, in order: (1) vite client stringifyConsoleArg ~380ms serializing the Vue 'missing template or render function' warning fired per pin mount — root cause is pb-xua (FA IconDefinition passed to MapIconTextPin's icon: Component prop); (2) Vue setFullProps/updateProps ~300ms — every pin re-renders on every fractional zoom tick because LandingPage passes raw zoom into ClusteredMarkers, though supercluster rounds internally and MapIconTextPin only uses zoom for size buckets (<12 dot, 12-14 small, >=14 large per map-core d.ts); (3) inherent maplibre Marker._update. Fix: cached FA wrapper components (stable identity, module-level cache in reportIcon.ts) closing pb-xua, and Math.round(zoom) at the ClusteredMarkers boundary in LandingPage (LocationAccuracyCircle keeps fractional zoom). Marker DOM churn at bucket crossings (279 adds/removals per 4s zoom) is inherent clustering behavior, acceptable once per-pin cost drops.
acceptance_criteria: Zero Vue warnings during zoom; pins re-render only on integer zoom crossings; wheel-zoom worst frame under ~100ms in dev; suite green.

title: knowledge-articles API: list-view queries ignore sort/direction/limit/offset
description: In 311-mobile-app/api shared/services/salesforce.ts getKnowledgeArticles, the 'if (list)' branch builds SOQL with no ORDER BY, LIMIT, or OFFSET — ?list=featured returns every record in the Salesforce list view (currently 7) in list-view order, ignoring the route's sort/direction/limit/offset params, which zod happily accepts. The web frontend works around it (FeaturedArticles.vue sorts by lastPublishedAt desc and slices to 4 client-side); the mobile apps presumably render whatever comes back. Fix belongs in the 311-mobile-app API repo — add ORDER BY/LIMIT/OFFSET to the list-view SOQL (the id-list WHERE clause makes this straightforward) or document that list views define their own order. When fixed, the client-side sort/slice in FeaturedArticles.vue can stay as a harmless belt-and-suspenders or be removed.

title: Primary-color token hygiene in philly-311 + packages/ui

title: ReportListingCard: match Figma card layout
description: Decision (Darren): match Figma exactly. File: apps/philly-311/frontend/src/components/ReportListingCard.vue. Figma card (node 10618:63345): 72px square thumbnail, 8px radius, left; content column: title row = serviceType label (Montserrat SemiBold 16) with a 24px circular status icon at the row's right — resolved: circle-check on success-container bg (#caecc8, icon #07570f); in-progress: clock on #e5cefa bg (icon #030831); below: address (14px); bottom row: timestamp 12px grey formatted 'MM/DD/YY • h:mm A' (e.g. '10/10/26 • 1:57 PM'); card separator = 1px bottom border #ccc; no card-level rounding/shadow. Remove vs current: status Tags pill overlaid on image (:29-34), colored service-type glyph before title (:37-44), colored dot + distance aside (:48-51). Check formatCardTimestamp output vs 'MM/DD/YY • h:mm A'. Map current statuses to the two icon treatments (check statusTagColor for the existing status set; closed/resolved -> check, everything open/in-progress -> clock).
acceptance_criteria: Card renders thumbnail, title + status icon, address, timestamp per Figma; no distance, no pill, no leading glyph; status icon has accessible label; component tests updated and pass.

title: Map: location-estimate accuracy circle at user position
description: Figma: translucent blue circle (~174px at city zoom) centered on the user's geolocated position (node 9789:29946 'Location Estimate'). Current: no accuracy circle anywhere in app; geolocation only seeds map center (apps/philly-311/frontend/src/composables/useReportFinder.ts:67-72); GeolocationButton from @phila/phila-ui-map-core in LandingPage.vue #map-content. Check first whether map-core's GeolocationButton/maplibre GeolocateControl already supports showAccuracyCircle; else add a maplibre circle layer sized from position.coords.accuracy (meters -> pixels by zoom). Fill: primary blue ~20% opacity, subtle stroke.
acceptance_criteria: After granting location, a translucent blue circle renders at user position scaled to reported accuracy, updates on re-locate, hidden when permission denied; tests cover the composable/layer logic; all tests pass.

title: philly-311: details per-question flow a11y follow-ups — focus management and required booleans
description: From pb-y25 final review, Details step (pages/report/DetailsStep.vue). (1) Focus management: auto-advance unmounts the focused radio; focus drops to <body> and the new question h1 isn't announced (no tabindex=-1+focus() or live region) — silent screen swap for screen-reader users on every picklist answer. Error messages are role=alert (fine); the happy path is quiet. Consider focusing the h1 on index change. (2) Required boolean questions: untouched Switch stores no value, so 'No' requires toggling on then off to register an answer; required check in next() sees empty and blocks. Pre-existing semantics from the old issue-type gate, now more visible one-per-screen. Consider seeding 'false' on first render of a boolean question or treating booleans as always-answered. Related: pb-41u (DateField label bug).

title: philly-311: Follow/Upvoted state on My Requests cards + detail Follow button
description: Figma request cards (311-Mobile-App file, frames 11124:10845/11201:95503) show 'Following'/'Upvoted' tags, and the detail frame (11124:11052) has Upvote + Follow buttons. Per Darren (2026-07-24): the 'follow' concept IS the upvote API — terminology shifted over time, they are the same system. Backing: GET /private/key/me/upvotes lists the user's upvotes; POST upvote exists in 311-mobile-app/api/apps/api/issue.ts. So: badge cards whose case appears in /me/upvotes, and wire the detail panel's Follow (or Upvote) action to the upvote endpoint. The ReportDetail case view (showCaseFields prop, src/components/ReportDetail.vue) currently omits these buttons — that omission was based on the mistaken belief Follow was unbacked. Decide final button label (Follow vs Upvote) with Darren before building.

title: Answers page: featured-articles card strip (list=featured endpoint)
description:
Figma: frame 10253:53625 — 4 white cards straddling the bottom edge of the hero banner, centered. Each card: trending-arrow icon + article title (14px body), white bg, 1px border-low (#ccc), 12px radius, 12px padding. In Figma they live in a horizontal 'Slider' (256px-wide cards) — at desktop 4 are visible; allow horizontal scroll on narrow widths.

These are 'featured articles' from the same 311 API route the browse list already uses, with query params:
  GET /private/key/knowledge-articles?list=featured&sort=lastPublishedAt&direction=desc&limit=4
(Darren's call 2026-07-23: newest-first by publish date, capped at 4.)
(Verified in 311-mobile-app/api/apps/api/knowledge.ts — list=featured maps to Salesforce list view 'Mobile_App_Featured_Articles'; iOS AppDataStore.swift hits the same param. Note: search and list params are mutually exclusive server-side.)

Implementation: extend loadArticles() in src/composables/useKnowledgeArticles.ts to pass list/sort/direction/limit through the query; new FeaturedArticles strip component in src/components/answers/. Cards link to /answers/:id like ArticleCard. If the featured fetch fails or returns empty, hide the strip (don't block the page).
acceptance_criteria: Strip renders newest-first featured articles (list=featured, sort=lastPublishedAt desc, limit=4) under the hero; cards match Figma tile style; each links to its detail page; empty/error hides strip; unit tests cover the composable params and the strip states.

title: Filter chips: single-row overflow with chevron pager
description: Figma: chips render in one non-wrapping row inside the 448px panel; overflow is handled by a floating 32px round white icon button (chevron, drop-shadow 0 4px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.15)) overlaid at the row's right edge to scroll/page to more chips. Current FilterChips.vue relies on FilterChipGroup default layout (wraps). Implement single-row horizontal scroll with the chevron affordance (hide when no overflow). Check FilterChipGroup API first for built-in overflow support before hand-rolling.
acceptance_criteria: Chips never wrap; chevron appears only when chips overflow; clicking scrolls to reveal hidden chips; keyboard/scroll accessibility preserved; tests pass.

title: Header nav: Map/Reports/Answers links, Report an issue button, Login/Sign up
description: Figma header (union-blue global menu): nav links Map, Reports, Answers; filled 'Report an issue' button; 'Login / Sign up' item; search icon. Current: PinboardShell.vue:24-45 passes :links="[]" to @phila/phila-ui-app-header AppHeader; only app-added item is Answers RouterLink via #navbar-end in apps/philly-311/frontend/src/App.vue:18-20. Changes: (1) Map -> '/' ; (2) Reports -> new stub route/page (decision: Reports page exists conceptually, not built — stub for now: route /reports + minimal page with heading, registered in router/index.ts); (3) keep Answers; (4) 'Report an issue' filled PhilaButton -> /report; (5) 'Login / Sign up' wired to @phila/sso-vue login (auth plumbing exists, see authGuard router/index.ts:37-59). Prefer AppHeader's links API over hand-rolled markup; PinboardShell may need a prop/slot passthrough since it's shared.
acceptance_criteria: Header shows Map, Reports, Answers, Report an issue button, Login / Sign up; Reports routes to stub page; Report an issue routes to /report; login triggers SSO flow; oem-flood-finder header unaffected; tests pass.

title: Pin icons never render on map markers (empty pin-icon span)
description: Found during pb-exd verification. ClusteredMarkers.vue passes serviceTypeIconDefinition() (a FontAwesome IconDefinition object from apps/philly-311/frontend/src/utils/reportIcon.ts) to MapIconTextPin's icon prop, which expects a Vue Component (e.g. IconLocationDot from @phila/phila-ui-core/icons). Vue warns 'Component is missing template or render function' per pin; DOM shows . Live pins are plain blue circles; design shows white glyphs (trash/car/etc.) on per-category colored circles. Fix pattern already exists in-repo: FilterChips.vue wraps FA definitions as functional components — do the same for pins (shared helper). Also design shows per-category circle colors; verify MapIconTextPin supports icon color per instance or needs the category color passed.
acceptance_criteria: Every pin shows its service-type glyph; per-category colors match FilterChips/design; Vue warning gone; tests cover the wrapper; suite green.

title: philly-311: Details-step per-question flow with auto-advance, error-on-next, exit/draft modal
description:
Match Figma 'Details (report flow)' (file aRmWuYVwmG9S2gXdJxCjqL, section node 10179:60134). Full implementation plan with complete code: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-22-details-question-flow.md

Scope:
- Service-request questions move from IssueTypeStep to DetailsStep, one per screen; question label is the heading with '* (required)' suffix; description (10-char floor) + contact + privacy remain the final screen.
- Auto-advance ~300ms after answering picklist questions (radio + large select); boolean/multipicklist/text/date stay manual Next.
- Wizard-wide error-on-next: Next always enabled; invalid attempt shows Figma error styling (container #f8c9bd, text #992100). Messages: 'Select an option to continue' (picklists), 'Add an answer to continue', 'Add a description to continue' (description), 'Select an issue type to continue' (issue step), 'Choose a location to continue' (location step). Darren's rationale: errors give more context than a disabled button.
- New useWizardNav composable: active step intercepts shell Back/Next (returns true=consumed) so DetailsStep can walk sub-screens; wizard shell falls back to route push.
- Exit link (replaces Reset, footer left; Back moves right next to Next per Figma) opens native <dialog> ExitDialog: Save draft / Discard / Cancel. Save -> new myCases Pinia store draft (localStorage key philly311:drafts) then reset + go '/'. Discard -> reset + '/'.
- myCases store is the foundation for the future Reports tab pulling logged-in user's cases from a separate endpoint (post-login work). Draft-restore UI deliberately deferred.

Key files: src/pages/report/DetailsStep.vue (rewrite), src/pages/report/IssueTypeStep.vue (drop questions), src/pages/ReportPage.vue (footer/nav), src/components/wizard/QuestionField.vue (error+hideLabel props), src/components/wizard/ExitDialog.vue (new), src/composables/useWizardNav.ts (new), src/composables/useWizardValidity.ts (showErrors), src/stores/myCases.ts (new), src/types/wizard.ts (ReportDraft).
